data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Contradiction. The preference for better-corroborated theories (SRC_003) contradicts the claim that acting on corroboration necessarily assumes the future will resemble the past (SRC_001). Refuted If: It can be demonstrated that a rational agent can prefer a theory solely based on its current logical content and error-elimination history without forming any expectation, however implicit, regarding its future predictive success.
